start.title: 하나의 언어
start.text:
온 땅이 하나의 언어와 공통된 말을 가지고 있습니다.
사람들은 어디에 정착합니까?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Settle in the plain of Shinar
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 11:2 — As people moved eastward, they found a plain in Shinar and settled there.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Sail east across a great sea
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says the people settled in the plain of Shinar.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Scatter across the earth right away
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] The people did not scatter yet — that came later, as judgment.

unity.title: 하나의 말
unity.text:
당신은 이웃을 봅니다.
당신들은 어떻게 말합니까?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] You all speak the same language, one common speech
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 11:1 — The whole world had one language and a common speech.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Every family speaks a different tongue
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says everyone spoke one language at this point.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] No one speaks at all
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says the people spoke — with one common speech.

proposal.title: 제안
proposal.text:
사람들이 모입니다.
그들은 무엇을 짓자고 제안합니까?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] 'Let us build a city, and a tower that reaches to the heavens — and make a name for ourselves'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 11:4 — They said, 'Come, let us build ourselves a city, with a tower that reaches to the heavens, so that we may make a name for ourselves.'

choices.text: [TODO:ko] 'Let us build an altar to the Lord'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says they built a city and a tower to make a name for themselves, not an altar.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] 'Let us go back and travel alone'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says the people stayed together to build.

bricks.title: 벽돌과 역청
bricks.text:
당신은 위대한 작업을 위한 재료를 모읍니다.
어떻게 건축합니까?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Make bricks and bake them thoroughly, using tar for mortar
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 11:3 — They said, 'Come, let's make bricks and bake them thoroughly.' They used brick instead of stone, and tar for mortar.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Cut stones from the mountains
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says they used bricks and tar, not cut stones.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Weave the tower from reeds
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says they used baked bricks and tar.

construction.title: 도시와 탑
construction.text:
작업이 시작됩니다.
당신들은 함께 무엇을 짓습니까?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Build a city and a tower with its top in the heavens
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 11:4-5 — They set out to build a city and a tower with its top in the heavens.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Build separate homes far from one another
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says they built one city together, not scattered homes.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Build a bridge across the sea
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says they built a city and a tower, not a bridge.

rising.title: 점점 더 높이
rising.text:
탑이 하늘로 솟아오릅니다.
사람들은 왜 계속 짓습니까?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] To make a name for themselves, so they will not be scattered over the earth
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 11:4 — 'Let us make a name for ourselves, and not be scattered over the face of the whole earth.'

choices.text: [TODO:ko] To honor the Lord who made the heavens
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says they built to make a name for themselves, not to honor the Lord.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] To hide from a coming flood
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] God had already promised never again to flood the earth (Genesis 9).

summit.title: 주님께서 내려오시다
summit.text: 탑이 솟아오릅니다. 다음에는 무슨 일이 일어납사까?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] The Lord comes down to see the city and the tower
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 11:5 — The Lord came down to see the city and the tower the people were building.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] The tower reaches heaven and the people enter it
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis does not say the tower reached heaven; the Lord came down to see it.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Angels descend to help the workers build
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis does not describe angels helping to build.

gods_gaze.title: 주님의 결정
gods_gaze.text:
주님께서 사람들에 대해 말씀하십니다.
그분은 무엇을 하시기로 결정하십니까?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] 'Come, let us go down and confuse their language'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 11:6-7 — The Lord said, 'Come, let us go down and confuse their language so they will not understand each other.'

choices.text: [TODO:ko] 'Let us praise their great work'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says the Lord confused their language, not praised the tower.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] 'Let us destroy the tower with fire'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says the Lord confused their language and scattered them, not that He destroyed the tower with fire.

confusion.title: 이상한 말
confusion.text:
당신은 이웃에게 돌아서서 말합니다.
무슨 일이 일어납니까?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] You can no longer understand one another's speech
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 11:7 — The Lord confused their language so they could not understand each other.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Everyone suddenly speaks even more clearly
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says their speech was confused, not made clearer.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Everyone falls silent and never speaks again
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says the languages were confused, not that speech ended.

scattering.title: 온 땅에 흩어지다
scattering.text:
건축이 멈춥니다.
사람들에게 무슨 일이 일어납니까?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] The Lord scatters them from there over all the earth, and they stop building the city
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 11:8 — The Lord scattered them from there over all the earth, and they stopped building the city.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] The people stay in Shinar and finish the tower
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says they stopped building and were scattered.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] The people sail back to Eden
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says they were scattered over the whole earth, not that they returned to Eden.

reflection.title: 바벨
reflection.text:
그래서 그 도시의 이름이 바벨이라 불렸습니다.
이는 주님께서 온 세상의 언어를 거기서 혼란하게 하셨기 때문입니다.
